independent_unit: same eight schools paired across timestep grids; no additional independent schools
shared_model: Byte-identical exposed dolphin and dense-gannet sources; samephysicalparameters,prNGs,readiness,schoolgeometries,setupdeclaration and captureq. Only numericaldt changes; no policy/threshold/lag/seed tuning.
change_scope: Compare36T fine runs with sealed36T coarse checkpoints from72T parent runs. Keep whole coarse runs immutable. Record absorbing depletion if encountered; no postdepletion effort extrapolation.
analysis: Report per-school D(DG-D) and G(DG-G), mixed-case captures,effort,fishsurvival and depth for both grids and paired grid differences. Two grids diagnose sensitivity and do not establish convergence or timestep independence.
execution_gate: Require root approvalreceipt tied to protocol/sourcefreeze plus complete all24coarse cases beforefine native pool; max3fineworkers aftercoarse pool exits. No finer native calls during preflight/tests.
